seo.title: Work With Me | Priya Raghavan
seo.description: Executive advisory, leadership team intensives and keynotes. Six advisory clients at a time. Engagements from $45,000.

blocks.heading: Three ways in. All of them start with the same call.
blocks.subheading: I take six advisory clients at a time. That constraint is not scarcity marketing — it is the number of people I can do this depth of work with while still doing it properly.

services.name: Executive Advisory
services.description: Six months, one-to-one, through all four pillars of the method. You finish with a settled position, a documented evidence library, a named framework and a twelve-month distribution plan you can run without me.
services.forWhom: Founders and C-suite leaders at $20M-$500M companies

services.name: Leadership Team Intensive
services.description: A compressed version run across your senior team, so the company narrative and the individual narratives reinforce each other instead of competing. Two full days on site plus eight weeks of follow-through.
services.forWhom: Executive teams of four to nine people

services.name: Keynotes
services.description: A ninety-minute working session disguised as a keynote. Audiences leave with a scored diagnostic of their own authority gaps rather than a set of slides they will not revisit.
services.forWhom: Industry conferences, private offsites, portfolio events

blocks.heading: Three engagements, in detail
blocks.subheading: Used with permission. Figures are client-reported at engagement close.

results.headline: A chief executive with eleven years of category expertise and no external footprint
results.before: Zero inbound enquiries; no published point of view; panel invitations only
results.after: 14 qualified inbound conversations per quarter and two non-executive board appointments

results.headline: A founder whose diagnostic instinct became the company's primary sales asset
results.before: Nine-month average sales cycle; value explained differently by every rep
results.after: Four-month average cycle; the named framework opens every deck the team uses

results.headline: A managing partner published a thesis and became the person the press called
results.before: One outlet had ever covered the firm; no proprietary point of view in market
results.after: Quoted in four tier-one outlets within twelve months; fund closed above target

blocks.heading: Executive Advisory
blocks.body: Six months, fortnightly ninety-minute sessions, unlimited asynchronous review in between. I work through the four pillars in order and I do not skip. Between sessions I do the construction work; your commitment is roughly two hours a week of thinking and reviewing.
deliverables: Positioning statement, named enemy and three defensible claims, all pressure-tested
A quantified evidence library — outcomes, case narratives and third-party endorsements
Your named framework, built and stress-tested against live client situations
Signature talk structure plus a one-page point of view for circulation
Twelve-month distribution plan across three channels with a sustainable cadence
Warm introductions where my network genuinely overlaps your target rooms
idealFor: You lead a company between $20M and $500M in revenue
You have a real record that is currently invisible outside your own building
You are willing to narrow your position and lose part of the market on purpose
You can commit two hours a week for six months

media.alt: Priya Raghavan working with a client

testimonials.quote: I expected a communications coach. What I got was someone who reorganised how I think about my own record and then made it impossible to ignore. The board conversations started arriving unprompted.
testimonials.author: Daniel Weiss
testimonials.result: Two board invitations in nine months

testimonials.quote: The framework we built in month three is now the first slide of every deck our sales team uses. It has outlived the engagement by two years and counting.
testimonials.author: Ama Osei
testimonials.result: Sales cycle cut from nine months to four

testimonials.quote: Priya is the only advisor I have worked with who told me to say less. It was the most profitable advice I received that year, and it was in week two.
testimonials.author: Marcus Hale

blocks.heading: Who this works for, and who it does not
forWhom: You lead or co-lead a company between $20M and $500M in revenue
You have a track record you are tired of explaining from scratch
You will take a position that costs you part of the market
You want to be cited by others, not merely followed
You can protect two hours a week for six months
notForWhom: Follower growth is the outcome you are buying
You are pre-revenue and need a narrative to raise on
You want content written in your voice while you stay uninvolved
You will not publish anything that could be argued with
You need visible external results inside sixty days

blocks.heading: Tell me what you have built.
blocks.subheading: Four questions. I read every one myself and reply within two business days either way.

form.consentNote: Your answers stay between us. I do not add applicants to any mailing list.

fields.name: situation
fields.label: What prompted you to look for help now?
fields.placeholder: The specific thing that happened recently is more useful to me than a general description.

reassurance: Read by me, not by an assistant
blocks.afterSubmit: If there is a plausible fit I will send two or three times for a thirty-minute call. If there is not, I will tell you why and, where I can, point you to someone better suited.
